about.headline: Researcher. Course builder. Community organizer.
paragraphs: Across research, classrooms, and volunteer organizations, I’m drawn to the same challenge: bringing structure to complexity and helping people learn, build, and contribute.

This site is designed to grow with the work. Research case studies can expand with methods and publications; course stories can add curricula and learner outcomes; leadership roles can document initiatives and community impact.
